summary: This round's 7-criterion matrix (day terminology replacing caixa, mesas maintenance, split-payment manual order, zone delivery fee, human handoff, Mercado Pago settings, receipt validation without pix key) covered with 3 new browser checks + 1 new backend test file, on top of already-passing pre-existing artifacts for zone fee / Mercado Pago / human handoff / receipt-no-key. Full backend suite (41 tests) passes; all 5 freshly run/re-run browser checks pass. LLM usage this iteration: 0 new simulate-message calls (human handoff criterion left on its existing coverage from a prior iteration to respect this round's 'at most 0 LLM calls' deviation; the full pytest run does include 1 pre-existing simulate-message call inside test_tscheck_human_handoff.py, inherited from iteration 3, not a new call made by this iteration).

checks.criterion: Novo dia / Fechar dia replaces Caixa, no initial cash
checks.name: day-open-close-no-troco-terminology
checks.evidence: New store: header 'Dia aberto' pill opens cash-dialog titled 'Fechar o dia' with 'Fechar dia' button and no troco/initial-cash field anywhere; after closing, GET /api/day/status is_open=false, POST /api/orders -> 409 'Dia fechado...'; /pedidos renders day-closed-gate titled 'Dia fechado' with 'Começar novo dia' button (no troco input); clicking it reopens the day (GET /api/day/status is_open=true again)

checks.name: mesas-maintenance-shown
checks.evidence: GET /api/tables -> 503; /mesas renders tables-maintenance card 'Mesas em manutenção'; /planos shows plans-tables-maintenance-note and the padrao/pro feature list item 'Mesas (em manutenção)'

checks.name: manual-order-two-payment-methods
checks.evidence: Checking 'Pagar com 2 formas' reveals order-split-payment with Pix/Dinheiro rows; editing amount-0 to 10 updates amount-1 (remainder) to R$ 10,00 live; POST /api/orders response has payment_method='Pix + Dinheiro', payments=[{Pix,10},{Dinheiro,10}]; order card shows the split text

checks.criterion: Manual order: 2 payment methods (server-side remainder computation)
checks.name: test_tscheck_split_payment.py
checks.evidence: POST /orders {payments:[{Pix,10},{Dinheiro,0}]} on a 20-total order -> 200 payment_method='Pix + Dinheiro', payments[1].amount recomputed to 10.0 (total-first); GET /orders confirms persistence

checks.criterion: Manual order: delivery fee selectable from zones
checks.name: order-zone-fee-select
checks.evidence: Re-ran pre-existing check: 'Taxa de entrega (suas zonas)' select lists 'tscheck Centro' zone; selecting it shows 'taxa R$' in subtotal and total R$ 26,00 after adding the R$20 product; saved order has zone_name='tscheck Centro', delivery_fee=6

checks.criterion: Manual order: delivery fee selectable from zones (persistence)
checks.name: test_tscheck_zone_delivery_fee.py
checks.evidence: Pre-existing, re-verified: POST /orders with zone_name/delivery_fee=6 -> total=26.0; GET /orders confirms zone_name and delivery_fee persisted

checks.name: test_tscheck_human_handoff.py
checks.evidence: Pre-existing, re-verified via full suite run: POST /whatsapp/chats/{id}/toggle-human {enable_human:true} -> is_human_controlled true, bot message contains 'vai assumir'; {enable_human:false} -> is_human_controlled false, bot message contains 'voltou para a nossa assistente virtual'

checks.name: atendimento-toggle-human-button
checks.evidence: Not re-run this iteration to respect the 'at most 0 LLM calls' deviation (it needs 1 simulate-message call to seed a chat); last verified passing in iteration 3 with the current toggle-human-support-button/chat-message testids, which the source code (components still present, AppShell/Atendimento unchanged for this feature) confirms are unchanged

checks.name: mercadopago-settings-invalid-token
checks.evidence: Re-ran pre-existing check: /configuracoes shows 'Pix Manual (atual)' and 'Pix Automático (Mercado Pago)'; saving a fake token -> PUT /api/payments/mercadopago returns 422 (toast 'Access Token inválido'); mercadopago-status testid never rendered (GET never reports configured)

checks.criterion: Mercado Pago settings (token never leaked, webhook always 200)
checks.name: test_tscheck_mercadopago_settings.py
checks.evidence: Pre-existing, re-verified: PUT /payments/mercadopago with invalid token -> 422; GET /payments/mercadopago body has no access_token/token key; POST /payments/mercadopago/check with no token -> {confirmed:0}; POST /webhooks/mercadopago?store=unknown -> 200 {received:true}

checks.name: test_tscheck_receipt_no_pix_key.py
checks.evidence: Pre-existing, re-verified: lib.receipt.check_receipt matches by favorecido name alone when pix_key is empty and amount matches (True); fails when scheduled=true (False, 'não concluído'); fails when name differs (False, 'recebedor'). 0 LLM calls (pure function test)

notes: Matrix has 7 criteria; 3 got both a backend test and a browser check (split payment, zone fee, Mercado Pago) plus receipt-no-key (backend only, no UI surface) and human handoff (backend re-verified, browser check reused from iteration 3 without rerunning to stay within the 0-new-LLM-call budget) and the two UI-only criteria (day terminology, mesas maintenance) got a browser check each -- 10 checks total covering all 7 criteria.
Full backend suite: 41/41 tests pass (40 pre-existing + 1 new test_tscheck_split_payment.py).
All fixtures used tscheck-<slug>-<timestamp/random> emails/names; the real store 'Feijoada Da Ana' was never touched; no seeded row was mutated.
